programme.title: Tonight
programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? GPs and pharmacists are raising concerns that drugs including codeine, oxymetazoline and antihistamines present significant dangers of becoming habit-forming, even addictive if not used correctly. Sam Holder examines a hidden dependence that can devastate lives and cause long term health problems. He meets those struggling to come off drugs that can be bought in any high street pharmacy without a prescription, and we hear from specialists who warn of what can happen in extreme cases of overuse.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.desc: Fast-moving action thriller. Kim is the pride and joy of her father Bryan Mills, who left the Central Intelligence Agency to be near her in California. programme.title: Tonight
programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? GPs and pharmacists are raising concerns that drugs including codeine, oxymetazoline and antihistamines present significant dangers of becoming habit-forming, even addictive if not used correctly. Sam Holder examines a hidden dependence that can devastate lives and cause long term health problems. He meets those struggling to come off drugs that can be bought in any high street pharmacy without a prescription, and we hear from specialists who warn of what can happen in extreme cases of overuse.

programme.title: Tonight
programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? GPs and pharmacists are raising concerns that drugs including codeine, oxymetazoline and antihistamines present significant dangers of becoming habit-forming, even addictive if not used correctly. Sam Holder examines a hidden dependence that can devastate lives and cause long term health problems. He meets those struggling to come off drugs that can be bought in any high street pharmacy without a prescription, and we hear from specialists who warn of what can happen in extreme cases of overuse.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: Tonight
programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? GPs and pharmacists are raising concerns that drugs including codeine, oxymetazoline and antihistamines present significant dangers of becoming habit-forming, even addictive if not used correctly. Sam Holder examines a hidden dependence that can devastate lives and cause long term health problems. He meets those struggling to come off drugs that can be bought in any high street pharmacy without a prescription, and we hear from specialists who warn of what can happen in extreme cases of overuse.

programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? GPs and pharmacists are raising concerns that drugs including codeine, oxymetazoline and antihistamines present significant dangers of becoming habit-forming, even addictive if not used correctly. programme.title: An Affair in Mind
programme.desc: 1988. Crime Drama. Directed by Colin Luke. Stars Amanda Donohoe, Stephen Dillane & Hilary Mason. A young novelist falls for a married woman, who then wants him to kill her husband. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life A Dog's Life
programme.desc: 1960. A film looking at London from a dog's point of view, from the family pet to the pampered pooch.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Three Wise Men. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray. A young man is told he has less than a year to live and is determined to spend Christmas with his wife and kids. [S]

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Just Like a Woman. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Steven Grives & Alfie Bass. Ash and Machin are brought to London from a bomb disposal course and attend to a dangerous bomb.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Indian Tree. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: I Love Trouble
programme.desc: 1948. Crime Drama. Directed by S. Sylvan Simon. Stars Franchot Tone, Janet Blair & Janis Carter. A prominent politician hires a private detective to investigate his wife's mysterious past. [S]

programme.title: Who Killed the Cat?
programme.desc: 1966. Drama. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Stars: Mary Merrall, Ellen Pollock, Mervyn Johns. A widow persecutes three old ladies, but fate takes its revenge. [S]

programme.title: The Monkey's Paw
programme.desc: 1948. Horror. A curio dealer sells a monkey's paw that can grant the possessor three wishes but warns that disaster will follow. Starring Michael Martin-Harvey, Sydney Tafler & Alfie Bass. [S]

programme.title: Tread Carefully
programme.desc: 1960s road tyre safety. Discussed with professor Unwin and Raymond Baxter of 'Tomorrows World'.

programme.title: Star Performance: The Gift
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Charles Boyer, Maureen O'Sullivan & Dan Tobin. Businessman Carl is a good boss for 364 days a year, but his mood changes when Christmas arrives. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Big Ben Lewis. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Six men are to be hanged for murdering Sir James Gilbert. Big Ben Lewis is fighting their case. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Theft of Excalibur. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A knight is held to ransom. The price for his release is King Arthur's sword, Excalibur. [S]

programme.title: The Abominable Snowman
programme.desc: 1957. Horror. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Forrest Tucker, Peter Cushing & Maureen Connell. Scientists on an expedition in the Himalayas discover a legendary creature may be real after all. [S]

programme.title: The Ship That Died of Shame
programme.desc: (AKA PT Raiders) 1955. Thriller. Director Basil Dearden. Stars Richard Attenborough, George Baker and Bill Owen. A trio of ex-servicemen begin smuggling black market items into post-war Britain. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Police Killer. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 37 year old Detective Sergeant Robert Kidd was murdered in September 1895. His life taken in the line of duty. [S]

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Etta Smith. 1995. Michael Aspel delves into another fascinating and extraordinary story - how Etta Smith succeeded where the Los Angeles Police Department failed with her psychic powers. [S]

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: No Hard Feelings. 1973. Stars Robin Chadwick, Richard Easton & Jean Anderson. The Hammond Board vote to buy out Harry Carter. Ann plays her final hand in her game to get Brian to take her back. [S]

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Strong Man Out. 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Neil McCallum & Robert Dorning. After a diamond robbery Mark Saber is called in to investigate. The only suspect is an aging employee but he is blind... [S]

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters...
programme.desc: ...Social Club. Episode 1. 1974. Freddie Garrity sings Try a Little Tenderness and Good Morning Starshine. Barbara Law performs Happy Heart, and Tessie O'Shea sings three numbers. [S]

programme.title: Angel On My Shoulder
programme.desc: 1946. Comedy. Director: Archie Mayo. Stars: Paul Muni, Anne Baxter & Claude Rains. The Devil arranges for a deceased gangster to return to Earth as a judge to make up for his previous life. [S]

programme.title: Nor the Moon By Night
programme.desc: 1958. Adventure. Director: Ken Annakin. Stars Michael Craig, Belinda Lee, Patrick McGoohan. After a the loss of her mother, a young women sets out to find her African pen pal. [S]

programme.title: Tonight
programme.desc: Are you in danger of developing a dependence on easily available over-the-counter medicines like codeine, nasal decongestants or sleeping aids? GPs and pharmacists are raising concerns that drugs including codeine, oxymetazoline and antihistamines present significant dangers of becoming habit-forming, even addictive if not used correctly. Sam Holder examines a hidden dependence that can devastate lives and cause long term health problems. He meets those struggling to come off drugs that can be bought in any high street pharmacy without a prescription, and we hear from specialists who warn of what can happen in extreme cases of overuse.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?
